sections.heading: The experimental study: what the criteria actually reward
paragraphs: Justification, mostly. Every decision in the write-up has to be explained rather than reported. Which published study, and why that one. Which variable was manipulated, which was measured, and how each was operationalised in terms a stranger could repeat. Which sampling method, and what that choice costs. Which statistical test, and why that test fits this data rather than another. A student who writes "participants were selected by opportunity sampling" has reported. A student who writes why opportunity sampling was the only honest option in a school of a certain size, and what it does to the result, has justified.

The second thing the criteria reward is self-criticism with a fix attached. Generic limitations earn nothing: small sample, not generalisable, demand characteristics. Specific ones earn plenty, especially when paired with a modification somebody could actually make. If the experiment ran in a classroom after lunch and the measured variable was recall, the tiredness is a real confound and the fix is a counterbalanced running order rather than a vague wish for more participants. The third thing they reward is honest interpretation: saying what the data showed, what it did not show, and how that sits against the original study's findings, including when the replication failed to reproduce them. A failed replication written up with clear reasoning is not a bad study and students need telling that, usually twice.

The written papers and the Higher Level extension sit alongside this and share almost no preparation with it, which is why the component gets neglected until it is urgent. The one genuine overlap is research methods: a student who has operationalised her own variables and chosen her own test reads a study in an examination paper with completely different eyes. A Psychology tutor in Mumbai who teaches the component as a methods exercise rather than as a piece of writing is giving your child something she will use in the papers too. For the exact assessment criteria and what each one is called this year, go to the current IB Psychology subject guide.
bullets: Every design decision explained, not reported: study, variables, sample, test
Variables operationalised so a stranger could repeat the procedure exactly

sections.heading: Why the teacher's approval date matters more than the Mumbai school deadline
paragraphs: Because nothing can legitimately happen before it. The supervising teacher has to see and approve the proposed design, including the ethical arrangements, before a single participant is recruited. A student who runs her experiment first and seeks approval afterwards may be told to discard the data and start again, which costs her a month she does not have. Treat the approval date as the real deadline and the submission date as its consequence.

Mumbai DP schools handle that sequence differently and the variation is wider than parents expect. At schools such as Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo and Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, the proposal, the approval, the data collection window and the draft deadline are usually separate dated checkpoints set out at the start of the year. Elsewhere the student is simply told a final date and left to organise the rest, which is where things go wrong. Ask your coordinator for the checkpoint dates in the first month and write them down, because a tutor planning around a submission date alone will plan the sequence backwards wrongly.

The calendar collisions are predictable. The approval and collection phase tends to land in the same term as the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) exhibition work and the other subject internal assessments, and in DP2 it competes with the mock examinations. We name these schools because their checkpoint habits are the practical context, nothing more: IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with Jamnabai Narsee International School, Aditya Birla World Academy, Hiranandani Foundation School or any other school on this page, and we do not guarantee grades. The useful thing a tutor does in this window is protect the sequence: proposal properly argued, approval obtained, data collected cleanly once, and the write-up started while the memory of running the experiment is still fresh.

sections.heading: Does home tuition or online work better for an experimental write-up?
paragraphs: They win at different phases, so the honest answer is both and in this order. Reading a published study together, arguing about what to operationalise and dismantling a first draft are all better in person, with paper on a table. Checking a statistical calculation, fixing a results table and answering a question two days before an approval deadline are better online. Most families book in person for the thinking and online for the chasing, and that split is how IB psychology IA help in Mumbai is usually arranged.

Home tuition is the lead service and it suits the design phase particularly well. A home tutor for Psychology Mumbai parents engage can sit with the journal article and the student's notes side by side, draw the design on paper until the independent and dependent variables are actually separate things, and watch your daughter write a standardised instruction sheet that a stranger could follow. For a student who is embarrassed about not understanding a method, an adult in the room is less exposing than a video call, and that matters more than any feature comparison.

An IB online tutor in Mumbai earns her place on timing and on supply. The approval window is short and unpredictable, and a tutor who can give thirty minutes on a Thursday morning when the teacher has asked for a revised procedure is worth more than one who can only come on Saturdays. The pool of experimental study supervisors in this city is also thin, so insisting on somebody within a short drive narrows it hard. The trade-off is real: statistics taught over a screen needs the student working the numbers herself with the tutor watching, not the tutor working them while the student watches, and a weak connection makes that difficult to police. Settle the default mode, the fallback and whether the rate changes without travel before the first session, not in the week of the deadline. IB home tuition in Mumbai with an online fallback is the pattern that survives DP2.

sections.heading: How do you tell a coach from a ghostwriter on a Psychology IA?
paragraphs: Hand over a real draft and read what comes back. Coaching returns questions and instructions addressed to the student: why this variable, where is the justification for this test, what would a reader need in order to repeat this. Ghostwriting returns better sentences. You will know within ten minutes of reading the returned file, and that ten minutes is worth more than any profile you will ever read.

Our own checks run before that. Every IB private tutor Mumbai families reach through IB Gram has had identity documents matched to the profile, the paperwork behind the claimed qualification seen rather than described, a reference from a school or a previous family, and a subject conversation with somebody who knows the course. For this component we add two questions: how would you handle a student who brings you data she did not collect, and how would you teach an inferential test without doing the calculation for her. The answers sort the field quickly. Parents sometimes ask us for the best IB tutor in Mumbai for Psychology; on an internal assessment the right person is the one who will disappoint your child on purpose.

Three checks only you can run. Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade on an internal assessment, because the mark is set by the school's marking and the IB's moderation and not by anybody you hire. Decline any offer of a sample write-up from a previous student, which is a faster route into an academic honesty investigation than most families realise. And keep every draft with its date, along with the raw data sheets in your daughter's own handwriting, so the progression from a confused first attempt to a defensible final version exists as evidence if a question is ever asked. We verify what can be verified and we do not guarantee grades; the authenticity of this work belongs to the student and cannot be delegated.

sections.heading: Choosing a study you can actually replicate in a Mumbai classroom
paragraphs: The single most common failure is choosing a famous study instead of a runnable one. A student reads about obedience, conformity or prison roles, finds it fascinating, and proposes something that cannot be done ethically by a seventeen year old in a school room and should not be attempted. The ethical guidelines exist precisely to rule that out, and a teacher will refuse the proposal, usually after the student has lost two weeks to it. The studies that work are the undramatic ones with a clean manipulation and a countable outcome: word list recall under different conditions, interference effects on reaction time, the influence of a leading question on a recalled detail, serial position in a memory list, the effect of a schema-activating title on what people remember from a passage.

Run four tests on any candidate study before the proposal is written. Can the manipulation be delivered identically to every participant with nothing more than printed sheets, a timer and a quiet room. Is the outcome a number rather than an impression. Can it be completed inside the time a school will actually give you, in one sitting, without the participants talking to each other in between. And does it stay inside the IB's ethical guidelines on consent, withdrawal, debriefing, anonymity and participant age, which your teacher will check against the current guide rather than against anybody's memory of it. A proposal that passes all four is usually approved on the first attempt, and first-attempt approval is the difference between a comfortable term and a frantic one.

The scope trap has a quieter version too. A student picks a workable study and then adds a second variable because one feels thin, and ends up with a design she cannot analyse with the test she has been taught. Thin is fine here. The criteria reward the quality of the justification and the honesty of the evaluation, not the ambition of the design, and a plain two-condition experiment argued carefully beats a clever three-way design explained vaguely. IB psychology IA help in Mumbai is at its most useful in exactly this week: the week when somebody experienced tells your daughter that her simple idea is good enough and she should stop decorating it. Mumbai classrooms also impose a practical limit nobody mentions, which is noise, so a procedure that depends on silence needs a room booked rather than assumed.

sections.heading: What should progress look like from proposal to final draft?
paragraphs: In four milestones, not in weekly increments. First, a candidate study your daughter can explain in her own words and defend as runnable. Second, an approved proposal with the ethics settled. Third, data collected once, cleanly, with the raw sheets kept. Fourth, a draft that justifies rather than reports. Measure IB psychology IA help in Mumbai against those four milestones and ignore how busy the sessions feel.

A worked example from a DP1 student in Chembur. Her first proposal was a replication she had read about in a magazine, with a dependent variable she could not describe without using the word "confidence". Two sessions of questions later she had moved to a word list recall study with a condition she could deliver from a printed sheet, and her teacher approved it the first time she submitted it. She then collected data twice, because the first run was done during a lunch break in a corridor and half her participants had heard the instructions wrongly. That second run was the most useful thing that happened to her all term: her evaluation section, usually the thinnest part, had a genuine specific limitation in it with a real modification attached, and she could write about standardisation from experience rather than from a textbook. Her written papers improved as a side effect, which is the normal pattern.

We do not guarantee grades, and no honest Psychology teacher will attach a number to an internal assessment before it has been marked and moderated. What we will tell you is when to change something. The warning signs are specific to this component: a draft whose sentences get smoother while the justification stays absent, a student who cannot say why her statistical test was the right one, a tutor who answers an ethics question by promising to check the guide and never checking, or raw data that exists only as a typed table with no original sheets behind it. The last one should be dealt with the same day. Three weeks of a poor fit before the approval date is survivable; three weeks after it is not, and Psychology home classes in Mumbai fail in the same quiet way as online sessions do.

The first session depends on where she is. Then book around the milestones rather than the calendar. Students who hear that from a parent stop asking, and tutors who hear it from a parent stop being asked. faqs.question: Can a tutor design the experiment or run the statistics for us?
faqs.answer: No, and an offer to do either should end the conversation. The write-up is declared as the student's own work, and the design decisions and the analysis are precisely what the criteria assess, so having them done for her removes the only part that earns marks and creates an academic honesty problem at the same time. A tutor may teach a statistical test on an unrelated set of numbers, may ask why one test fits better than another, and may point out that a results table is unreadable. The student does the calculation, writes the justification, and keeps the working.

faqs.question: Can a tutor come to our building in Bandra West on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, since Bandra West sits in the densest Diploma Programme pocket in the city and tutors from Khar, Santacruz, Mahim and the Bandra Kurla Complex side reach it without a long run. Two practical points. Ask your society about a standing visitor pass, because an irregular schedule plus a one-off gate entry each time wastes ten minutes at the desk. And expect sessions to be clustered rather than weekly on this component, so offer two possible evenings instead of one fixed hour and you will get a far better match.

faqs.question: Our daughter wants to replicate Milgram. Is that allowed?
faqs.answer: No, and her teacher will say so, so it is better to hear it now. Studies involving deception beyond the mildest kind, stress, discomfort or any risk to a participant fall outside the ethical guidelines this component is bound by, and the dramatic classics of social psychology are the obvious examples. The guidelines also cover informed consent, the right to withdraw, debriefing, anonymity and participant age. Redirect her early towards a clean cognitive study with a countable outcome. Students usually resist for one session and then find the simpler design more interesting once they are actually running it.

faqs.question: What ethical rules apply to the participants she recruits?
faqs.answer: The current IB Psychology subject guide sets them out and her teacher enforces them, so read the guide rather than any summary. In practice they cover informed consent in writing, a clear right to withdraw at any point, honest debriefing afterwards, anonymity in the write-up, a lower age limit for participants, and a prohibition on anything causing stress or harm. The practical consequence is that classmates and family friends above the stated age are the usual participant pool, and that consent forms have to exist as paper her teacher can see. Nothing is recruited before the design is approved.

faqs.question: Do we need our home for sessions, or does data collection happen at school?
faqs.answer: Coaching sessions happen at home or online; the data collection itself almost always happens at school, with the teacher's knowledge and in a room your daughter has arranged. A tutor has no role in the collection at all and should not be present for it. What a tutor can do beforehand is rehearse the standardised instructions until they are deliverable identically to every participant, which is the single most common reason a first data run gets wasted. Keep your home sessions for the reading, the design argument and the drafting.

faqs.question: Which statistical test should she use, and can the tutor pick it?
faqs.answer: She picks it and she justifies it, because the justification is what the criteria reward. A tutor's job is to make sure she understands what her data actually is, whether the design compares separate groups or the same participants twice, and what level of measurement she has, since those three facts determine the sensible options. Once she can state those, the choice follows and she can explain it in a sentence. A student who writes down a test name because a tutor told her to will be unable to defend it, and the absence of that defence is visible to a marker immediately.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for internal assessment coaching?
faqs.answer: The level, how scarce the specialism is, the travel distance, the session length and how much work happens outside the session. Internal assessment coaching is unusually heavy on out-of-session reading, because annotating a draft properly takes longer than the conversation about it, so ask whether draft reading is inside the hourly rate or billed on top. Experienced experimental study supervisors are scarcer across Mumbai than general Psychology teachers, which is the main upward pressure. We publish no figures on these pages; ask the tutor directly and get the rate and the cancellation terms in writing before the second session.

faqs.question: She collected data before the teacher approved the design. What now?
faqs.answer: Tell the teacher immediately and accept whatever she decides, which may be that the data cannot be used. That is painful and it is still the cheapest outcome available, because submitting work built on unapproved data collection is a far worse problem than losing a fortnight. In most cases the design can be approved with modifications and a second clean run is possible, especially if the first one was ethically sound and simply out of sequence. A tutor's job here is to help her write an honest account of what happened and to get the resubmitted proposal right the first time.

faqs.question: We live in Kharghar and most IB schools are in the Western Suburbs. Does that matter?
faqs.answer: Less than it would for a weekly subject arrangement, because this component is irregular and document-based. A tutor in Kharghar, Belapur or Nerul can coach a student whose school is in Juhu or Bandra perfectly well, and a tutor on the island can work with a Kharghar student online. We would not build a fixed weekday evening on a trans-harbour crossing even with the Atal Setu, but a clustered pattern of two or three in-person sessions at the milestones plus online contact in between works, and we match on experimental study experience first.

faqs.question: How long before the school deadline should we start?
faqs.answer: Before the approval date, not before the submission date, and ideally while your daughter is still reading candidate studies. The two weeks around choosing and proposing are where coaching changes the most, because a proposal approved on the first attempt saves a month of rework. Starting after the data is collected still helps the write-up, but a flawed procedure cannot be fixed retrospectively and a weak design limits what the evaluation can honestly say. If the deadline is close, start anyway and ask the tutor to be blunt about what is and is not recoverable, because late IB psychology IA help in Mumbai still beats none.

faqs.answer: No to both. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any school named on this page and not an agent of the International Baccalaureate. Schools appear here because their checkpoint dates and approval habits are the real constraint on when this work can happen. We check tutor identity, qualification paperwork, references and subject knowledge, and we do not guarantee grades, because the mark comes from the school's marking and the IB's moderation of the student's own work. sections.heading: Where does Psychology sit in the IB and IGCSE years?
paragraphs: Psychology is not a continuous subject from Year 1 to Year 12, which surprises parents who expect a ladder. In the Middle Years Programme (MYP) there is no Psychology course: the thinking skills arrive inside Individuals and Societies, where students meet evidence, bias and source handling without the vocabulary. Cambridge International Education offers a Psychology syllabus at IGCSE that some Mumbai schools run and many do not. In the Diploma Programme (DP) it becomes a full Group 3 subject at Standard Level and at Higher Level.

Working out the route takes one question to the right person. Ask the school's Diploma coordinator or the Individuals and Societies head which subjects appear on your child's registration and at which level, because parents routinely tell us HL when the registration says SL. If your child is doing Cambridge IGCSE Psychology, we have separate pages for that syllabus and its code, and they carry the detail this page deliberately does not. Our DP Psychology pages do the same for DP1 and DP2 formats, and our Psychology internal assessment page covers the experimental write-up in depth.

Tuition differs sharply across the three. An MYP student benefits from general argument and evidence work, not from Psychology content, and a tutor who starts teaching approaches to a Year 8 is wasting your money. An IGCSE student needs syllabus coverage plus command-term discipline. A DP student needs depth in a small number of studies, the ability to critique methodology, and essay timing under pressure. The HL student carries research methodology on top, which is a genuinely separate skill and the usual reason an HL student who was comfortable in DP1 struggles in DP2.

A home tutor for Psychology Mumbai parents book through IB Gram is matched to one of those three jobs, not to all of them at once. Generalists exist and some are excellent, but the subject rewards somebody who has read the current guide for the exact course your child sits. sections.heading: Papers 1, 2 and (HL) 3: what each one actually asks for
paragraphs: Paper 1 is built on the approaches to understanding behaviour: the biological, the cognitive and the sociocultural. Candidates answer shorter questions across all three and then write an extended response, and Higher Level candidates carry extensions within those approaches. The content is not the hard part. The hard part is that every claim has to be supported by a named study whose aim, procedure and findings the student can state briefly and then evaluate. A student who writes two confident paragraphs of general psychology with no study attached scores in the lower bands however fluent the prose is.

Paper 2 covers the options, and the options are chosen by the school rather than the student. Abnormal psychology, developmental psychology, health psychology and the psychology of human relationships each come with their own body of research, so revision for one is not revision for another. The number of options a candidate answers on differs by level, and the structure changes between subject guide cycles, so confirm both with your school's coordinator and the current guide rather than trusting an older revision book or a cousin's notes from a previous year.

Higher Level candidates sit a third paper on research methodology, built around an unseen abstract of a study. They are asked to identify and critique the design, the sampling, the ethics and the way conclusions were drawn, then suggest alternatives. This is the component that rewards drilling, because the question types repeat even though the abstract never does. It is also the component schools often reach last in the teaching order, which is why HL students arrive in the final term having barely practised it.

The internally assessed experimental study runs through all of this: a replication of a published study, planned, carried out and written up with inferential statistics and a proper discussion of ethics. We keep that short here because our Psychology internal assessment page owns it. The connected skill an IB psychology tutor in Mumbai should be building is the habit of reading any study as a set of choices that could have been made differently, which is what Paper 3 and the write-up both reward.

sections.heading: Why home tuition suits an essay subject
paragraphs: Essay subjects reward a tutor who can read over a shoulder. Home tuition lets the tutor watch a student plan an answer, stop them at the moment the plan goes wrong, and make them restart the paragraph rather than discussing it afterwards. Handwriting speed and legibility matter in Psychology because the extended responses are long, and a student who types everything at home will be writing slower than they think in the hall. None of that is visible on a video call.

The honest limitation of home visits is supply. An IB Psychology home tutor in Mumbai teaching three or four evenings inside one corridor is dependable; the same person covering South Mumbai on Monday and Kandivali on Wednesday is not, and will either raise the rate to cover dead travel time or start cancelling. Home classes also need a table, decent light and a door, because a Psychology session involves reading aloud and arguing, and nobody does that well in a living room with the television on.

Online earns its place differently here. Essay marking with a shared screen and tracked comments is genuinely good, often better than scribbles in a margin, and the student keeps a readable record of every correction. An IB online tutor in Mumbai also widens the option pool, which in Psychology is the real constraint: the specialist who has taught health psychology to examination standard may live in Thane while you live in Panvel. What online handles poorly is the student who stops writing when nobody is sitting next to them, and there are plenty of those.

Hybrid is the arrangement most of our Psychology families end up with. One visit a week for timed writing and study recall, one online session for essay marking and methodology drilling, then extra online hours before a deadline. Psychology home classes Mumbai families book in the far nodes often run fortnightly in person with weekly online marking in between, which is less elegant on paper and far more reliable in practice through July and August.

Then keep it observable week to week. Sessions in a shared room, a short written note on what was covered and set, and a quiet monthly conversation with your child when the tutor is not around. sections.heading: Can your child name a study, or only describe one?
paragraphs: This is the difference between a five and a seven, and it is why most families eventually look for an IB psychology tutor in Mumbai. A student who can retell a famous experiment as a story has done the reading. A student who can state its aim in one sentence, outline the procedure in two, give the finding, and then say what the sample, the setting and the ethics do to the strength of that finding has done the subject. The second student scores in the top bands with half the words.

Take a question asking the candidate to discuss one study investigating the role of a hormone in human behaviour. The weaker answer spends most of its length narrating the experiment and ends with a sentence saying it was useful. The stronger answer gives the study briefly, then spends its length on the parts that carry marks: whether the sample supports generalisation, whether a laboratory setting changes the behaviour being measured, whether the measure was reliable, whether a correlational design permits the causal claim the question implies, and whether the ethics were sound. The content is identical. The mark is not.

Command terms decide how much of each the examiner wants. Describe and outline want the study. Discuss, evaluate and to what extent want the critique and a judgement. Contrast wants the differences held side by side rather than two separate descriptions. Students lose whole bands by answering every prompt with the same essay, and no amount of extra content fixes it. The drill that works is short: read the command term aloud, write the plan in four lines, then check the plan against the term before writing a single paragraph.

The other quiet failure is study hoarding. A student with forty half-known studies performs worse than one with twelve they can deploy under pressure, because recall under time pressure collapses to whatever is genuinely secure. A Psychology IB and IGCSE, Years 1-12 tutor Mumbai families work with should be cutting the list down and making the student rehearse the remaining studies aloud, not adding more notes to a folder nobody reads twice.

sections.heading: Honest markers of progress in an essay subject
paragraphs: At four weeks the thing to look for is structure, not score. Can your child produce a four-line essay plan that names the studies before writing? Can they state one study's aim and finding without opening a book? Has the handwritten essay stopped running out of time halfway through the second argument? Those three are visible at home without a report card, and if none of them has shifted in a month the match is probably wrong rather than slow.

At one term the written work should look different on the page. Shorter narration of studies, more evaluation, a judgement sentence at the end of each argument, and essay plans that survive contact with an unfamiliar question. Mock marks may not reflect this yet, because examiners mark mocks hard on purpose and because one option paper can mask progress in the other. Ask the tutor which question types moved, then read the marked script yourself to check the claim rather than taking the summary.

Across a full cycle the honest statement is that accumulated essay practice and a secure, small bank of studies are what raise marks, and that we do not guarantee grades. Nobody can. The final result is shaped by the other subjects competing for revision hours, by the student's state in the examination fortnight, and by the option the department chose before your child had a say. A tutor who promises a specific number should be declined on principle, however good the rest of the conversation was.

Know what failure looks like so you can call it early. Sessions that become homework completion. Marking without a named band. No written record. A student who brightens when the session is cancelled. Tell us in week three and we move you to the next profile on the same shortlist, pass over the first tutor's diagnostic read so nothing is repeated, and charge nothing for the switch. One change is routine. A third change usually means we misread the brief, and we will go back over it with you properly rather than sending a fourth name.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be home during the session, and what about the building gate pass?
faqs.answer: Somebody adult should be in the flat, though not in the room. Psychology sessions involve reading aloud, arguing a position and being marked hard, and most teenagers do that better without a parent listening in. faqs.question: My child says Psychology is just common sense. Why are the marks low?
faqs.answer: Because common sense scores nothing without a named study attached to it. Marks come from stating a study's aim, procedure and finding briefly, then evaluating the sampling, the setting, the measurement, the design and the ethics, and finally answering the actual question asked. Fluent general writing with no research behind it sits in the lower bands no matter how sensible it sounds. The fix is a small bank of studies the student can recall cold, plus command-term drilling so the critique gets the length it deserves.

faqs.question: Which Paper 2 option has the school chosen, and does it change the tutor we need?
faqs.answer: It changes it significantly, and the school has to tell you. Abnormal psychology, developmental psychology, health psychology and the psychology of human relationships each carry their own research base, so a tutor fluent in one may be learning another from scratch alongside your child. Ask the Diploma coordinator in writing which option the class is taking and how many papers your child's level answers on, then send that to us. It is the single piece of information that most narrows the shortlist and most improves the match.

faqs.question: Is Psychology a soft option compared with Economics or Biology?
faqs.answer: No, and students who choose it believing that are the ones who come to us in January. The content is approachable and the assessment is not: it is an evidence subject marked on precision of recall and quality of critique, written by hand at length. Students who find Biology hard because of the volume often find Psychology hard for the same reason, with the added demand that every argument needs a study. It rewards reading and rehearsal. It punishes improvisation more than most Group 3 subjects do.

faqs.question: Does online Psychology tuition work as well as a home visit?
faqs.answer: For marking, yes, and sometimes better. A shared screen with tracked comments gives your child a readable record of every correction, which beats handwriting in a margin. For timed writing and study recall, a home visit is stronger, because the tutor sees the student stall and can intervene in the moment rather than reading the wreckage afterwards. Most families run one visit plus one online session a week. If your node has no option specialist, online is not a compromise, it is the only way to reach the right person.

faqs.question: We are in Airoli. How far does the Psychology pool actually stretch?
faqs.answer: Within Navi Mumbai, comfortably. Airoli, Ghansoli, Sanpada, Vashi, Nerul, Seawoods and Panvel are linked by the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines, Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, so node-to-node matching holds all year. Across the creek it gets unreliable: the Atal Setu has shortened the drive, but a Psychology specialist crossing weekly for one hour rarely keeps it up past week six. faqs.question: Our child needs help with the experimental study. Is that what this page covers?
faqs.answer: Only in outline. The internally assessed experimental study is a replication of a published study with its own planning, statistics, ethics and write-up requirements, and we keep a separate page for it so the advice can go properly deep. What belongs here is the connected habit: reading any study as a set of decisions that could have been made differently. If the write-up is your main problem, say so when you contact us and we will match a tutor who has supervised them rather than one who simply teaches the content well.

faqs.question: What drives the fee up or down for Psychology?
faqs.answer: Four factors, and none of them is popularity. The level, since Higher Level adds research methodology and a third paper. The scarcity of your school's option, which is the biggest single driver in this subject. The travel distance and the dead time it consumes. And the session length, because a ninety-minute timed-essay session is not the same product as an hour of question answering. We will give you a range for your actual request and tell you which factor is moving it, rather than publishing a city-wide figure that fits nobody.

faqs.question: How do we know the tutor is not just reading out of the textbook?
faqs.answer: Watch one session and look for three things. Does the tutor make your child write, rather than listening? Does every piece of marking end with a named band and a specific reason? Does the session produce a short written note of what was covered and set? A tutor who only explains content is pleasant and ineffective for this subject. The teaching that moves Psychology marks is uncomfortable: timed writing, cold recall, and criticism of an essay the student thought was finished.

faqs.question: Which months in the Mumbai school year hurt the most?
faqs.answer: October and January. The school year runs from June to March or April, and those two windows pull internally assessed work, essay-heavy unit tests and mock examinations into the same few weeks. A DP1 student in Tardeo or Juhu can have a Psychology essay, an experimental study proposal and a Theory of Knowledge commitment inside one fortnight. sections.heading: Where English sits inside the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP)
paragraphs: English in the International Baccalaureate (IB) Primary Years Programme (PYP) is not a subject with a textbook and a chapter list. It is a set of language strands, oral, written and visual, taught through units of inquiry that sit under the transdisciplinary themes. A child reads, writes, listens, speaks, views and presents in service of an inquiry about migration or materials or systems, and the language outcomes are assessed inside that work rather than in a separate English lesson.

This is why a PYP transdisciplinary learning tutor in Mumbai has to read before teaching. The unit planner tells her what the class is inquiring into this half-term, what the central idea is, which lines of inquiry the teacher has opened, and which language skills the teacher has attached to it. A tutor who ignores all of that and runs a generic comprehension worksheet is teaching a different subject from the one your child is reported on. A PYP transdisciplinary learning IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) tutor Mumbai families keep for more than one term is the one who asks for the planner in the first conversation, before quoting a rate.

The learner profile runs alongside the strands. Your child is being described as a communicator, an inquirer, a thinker and a risk-taker, and those words appear on reports where parents expect marks. English support that only lifts spelling accuracy will not move a report saying your child is reluctant to present her thinking to the class. In the early PYP years the weight sits on phonics, decoding, letter formation and talking in full sentences. By the upper years it has shifted towards structuring a piece of writing, saying where an idea came from, and presenting to an audience, which is what the final-year exhibition eventually draws on. The exhibition has its own pages on this site; what matters here is that the English habits it needs are built two years earlier.

Schools in Mumbai also differ in how formally they report PYP language. Some send home a strand-by-strand continuum, some send a narrative comment, and some hold a student-led conference where your child explains her own portfolio to you. Bring whichever of those you have to the first session, because it is the only written record of what the school thinks the gap is. The IB revises its language scope and sequence on its own cycle, so confirm the current structure with your school's PYP coordinator rather than trusting any summary, including this one.

sections.heading: What does a PYP English home tutor actually do in your flat?
paragraphs: The first twenty minutes are diagnostic and they happen out loud. The tutor hands your child a book slightly above her comfort level, listens to her read a page, and marks what went wrong: a substituted word, a skipped line, a guess made from the first letter, a full stop read straight through. Then a short written task at the same table, unaided.

Reading aloud is the one check that cannot be faked and cannot be done well through a laptop microphone. A child who reads accurately but flatly is decoding, not comprehending. A child who reads with expression and then cannot say what happened has been coached on fluency alone. A child who self-corrects without being told has the habit that matters most, and it is worth more than two reading levels. Running these checks in your living room means the tutor also hears what the room does to the reading: a television two metres away, a younger sibling who needs answering, a cook in the kitchen at the same hour every week. Those things are fixable, and nobody fixes them from a screen.

Writing is where PYP transdisciplinary learning home classes Mumbai parents book usually show the quickest visible change, because the problems are concrete. Sentences that run on for a whole paragraph. Every sentence starting with the same word. No paragraph breaks, because nobody has ever shown her where one goes. Vocabulary stuck at nice and good because the richer word was never said aloud in the house. A tutor at your dining table works on a real piece rather than an exercise: the actual reflection the actual unit of inquiry wants this week, drafted, read back, cut and rewritten. Spelling gets taught as patterns on physical cards that stay in the house between visits, not as a list to memorise on Thursday and forget by Monday.

Oral work is the part most online arrangements quietly drop. Presenting is assessed in the PYP, and a nine-year-old who mumbles at the floor in class will not practise standing up straight in front of a webcam. In a home session she presents to one adult in her own sitting room, then to a parent, then to a parent and a grandparent, which is the only progression that reliably works. Handwriting and pencil grip get seen and corrected rather than guessed at, and so does the sitting position, which is the single most common thing a screen-only tutor never notices.

sections.heading: Mumbai home tuition coverage, zone by zone
paragraphs: IB Gram matches PYP English tutors across all six of the city's teaching zones, and the match is made inside the zone almost every time. South Mumbai is dense and short-distance but slow: a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers a handful of kilometres and can still lose most of an hour to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak. Families in Cuffe Parade, Walkeshwar, Fort and Tardeo are matched inside the island rather than brought down from the suburbs, using the Western Line out of Churchgate and Grant Road, the Harbour Line towards Dockyard, Metro Line 3 between Cuffe Parade and BKC, and the Coastal Road.

The Western Suburbs run north to south along the Western Express Highway and the Western Line, so a tutor going from Bandra to Andheri is quick off-peak and painful at six in the evening. Matching along the line works: Khar West to Santacruz West, Malad to Kandivali, Borivali to Dahisar. Matching across it does not. Metro Line 1 from Versova through Andheri to Ghatkopar and Metro Lines 2A and 7 from Dahisar down to Gundavali have made pairings workable that were not workable a few years ago, and a tutor who uses the Metro rather than the Link Road is the one whose arrival time stops being a variable in your week.

The Central Suburbs sit on the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali hanging off JVLR in between. Powai is the odd one out: it is physically central and has no station of its own, so tutors reach Hiranandani Gardens and Chandivali by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar, and the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road carries the crossing from the west. The Eastern Suburbs stretch from Chembur and Govandi up through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund on the Central and Harbour lines, and the Eastern Freeway makes the island city reachable from Chembur and Wadala far faster than the map suggests. IB PYP English home tuition in Mumbai is easiest to schedule in these two zones for exactly that reason, because the tutor pool and the school pool overlap along the same roads.

Navi Mumbai is planned in nodes, Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, each a short drive from the next on Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, with the Harbour Line, the Trans-Harbour Line from Thane and the Belapur to Pendhar Metro underneath. Tutors are matched node to node, because pulling one across the creek from the island city for a weekday evening lesson rarely survives a full term even now that the Atal Setu has shortened the drive. Thane spreads west to east from the station across Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road, and the Ghodbunder stretch sets the schedule: a tutor living near Thane station reaches Kasarvadavali in twenty minutes off-peak and nearly an hour in the evening. When parents search IB tutors near me Mumbai, what they usually mean is near enough to be reliable in the rain, and that is the only definition we work to.

sections.heading: The Mumbai school calendar that sets your PYP English timetable
paragraphs: Mumbai's IB primary schools run June to April in three terms, with the heaviest reporting in October, December and March. That shape decides when English support helps and when it only adds pressure. Families at Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu, Oberoi International School at Goregaon East on JVLR, Dhirubhai Ambani International School in BKC, Bombay International School at Babulnath and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul deal with the same rhythm, whatever the differences in their reporting language.

June and July are the cheapest months to start and the ones parents skip. The new unit of inquiry has just opened, no report is imminent, and the monsoon has not yet eaten anyone's Tuesday. By mid-October, when the first proper report and the first student-led conference land together, a child who was already a reluctant writer is a reluctant writer with a comment about it in writing, and the work now has to be done under the eye of the school. December brings the mid-year report and the long holiday, which is the best block in the year for reading volume and the worst for routine. March is the end of the PYP year, portfolio season and the final-year exhibition presentations, and by then whatever reading habit exists is the one you have.

The monsoon is a scheduling fact rather than an excuse. Between late June and September a tutor coming to Chembur or Thane in the evening will be badly late once or twice in a term, and the honest arrangement is a named backup slot on a weekend morning rather than a cancelled week. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page; naming a school here describes the calendar and the board pathway its families follow, nothing more. We also do not guarantee grades or report comments. What a tutor can change is how much of the work your child can do without an adult sitting next to her, and in the PYP that is most of what a report is actually measuring.

Transitions matter more in the PYP than parents expect. A child moving from a state-board or CBSE primary into Grade 3 or Grade 4 of an IB school in Mumbai, Maharashtra arrives able to spell and unable to write a paragraph about her own thinking, because nobody has ever asked her for one. Those children need two terms of inquiry-shaped writing before the school's reports start to read like the rest of the class, and the first term of that is mostly unlearning the habit of waiting to be told the right answer.

sections.heading: Home, online or hybrid for IB PYP English in Mumbai
paragraphs: Home tutoring is the default for PYP English and should be. A child of six to eleven needs an adult in the room, a book she can hold, a pencil she can be corrected on, and a session she cannot minimise into another tab. Booking an IB PYP English home tutor in Mumbai for a fixed weekday evening also solves the thing no app solves, which is that the session happens whether or not your child feels like it that day.

Online has two real uses and one honest weakness. The uses are reach and continuity. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can be the specialist in Thane your Colaba search would never have produced, and an online slot survives a travelling parent, a cancelled driver or a week when the child is unwell but well enough to read. The weakness is that primary literacy is physical. A microphone flattens exactly the errors the tutor needs to hear: substitutions, hesitations, a breath taken in the wrong place. A tutor cannot see the pencil, cannot turn the book, cannot move the chair. For a nine-year-old working on the structure of a piece of writing, a good online session is worth most of a home session. For a six-year-old on phonics it is worth about half.

Hybrid is what most PYP families in Mumbai end up doing, usually by accident, and it is worth designing on purpose instead. One home visit a week for the reading check, the writing piece and the oral practice. One short online session midweek for the homework your child would otherwise do badly alone. Everything else by message, including the photograph of the page she got stuck on. It costs less than two home visits because travel is the expensive part of a Mumbai evening, and it stops the week's work collapsing into a single long block on Saturday.

The trade-off to say out loud is scheduling. A home slot is harder to move and easier to keep. An online slot is easier to move and therefore moves, and a slot that moves twice a month has stopped being a routine. If your family's evenings are genuinely unpredictable, take the home slot early in the week rather than the online slot late in it, and keep the same day for a full term before judging whether the arrangement works.

sections.heading: How is an IB PYP English home tutor in Mumbai checked before you meet them?
paragraphs: Identity and address are verified from a government photo document, the highest qualification is checked against the certificate, and any claim of IB experience is checked by asking for the school, the years, the programme and the role. A tutor who cannot produce a unit planner she has genuinely worked from does not reach your shortlist for a PYP English brief.

That last filter removes more applicants than the paperwork does. A great deal of English tutoring in Mumbai is excellent CBSE or ICSE tutoring with the labels changed. Those tutors lift grammar accuracy and comprehension speed quickly, and they are the wrong hire for a child whose report is written in terms of language strands and learner profile attributes. The screening conversation for every IB private tutor Mumbai parents are shown includes a question with no neat answer: what would you do with a unit on migration if the child reads two years below her grade. The reply separates the people who have taught in an IB primary from the people who have read about one.

There are four things only you can check, and they take one conversation. Ask the tutor to run a reading check in front of you in the first session and to tell you afterwards what she heard rather than how it went. Ask what she will send you after each visit. Ask what happens in the week she has a wedding in Pune. And be wary of any tutor who offers a guaranteed grade or a guaranteed reading level by a fixed date, because no honest teacher of a seven-year-old will promise that. For home visits, ask for a photo identity you can leave with your society gate, and keep sessions in a room with a door that stays open.

Every IB PYP English home tutor in Mumbai on the platform also agrees to a plain replacement rule, because screening is not prediction. If the fit is wrong after two sessions you say so and we move, without an argument about notice. The pattern we see repeatedly is a mismatch of pace rather than of knowledge: a careful tutor with an impatient child, or a brisk tutor with a child who needs to be allowed to finish her own sentence.

sections.heading: Why the home visit changes what a PYP English tutor can see
paragraphs: The argument for home tuition in primary English is not comfort, it is information. What an IB PYP English home tutor in Mumbai sees in forty minutes at your dining table is a list a screen cannot produce: which books are actually in the house and whether any of them sit at her level, whether the reading corner is a shelf or a cupboard nobody opens, whether the table she writes at is the table the family eats at twenty minutes later.

Here is the kind of thing that only surfaces in person. A Grade 3 child in Powai was described by two previous tutors as inattentive. The home tutor's second visit happened to fall at seven rather than six, and the television in the same room was on. The problem was never attention. A Grade 2 child in Khar West read well below her level from the school reader and fluently off the tutor's phone, because the print was small and nobody had checked her eyes. A Grade 5 child in Vashi wrote three lines in forty minutes for a tutor and two pages for her grandmother, because her grandmother asked her what happened next and the tutor asked her for a reflection. None of those three diagnoses can be made from a video call, and all three were made inside the first fortnight of a home arrangement.

The second thing the visit buys is the parent handover. Five minutes at the end of a home session, with your child present, is the most useful teaching a parent gets all week: this is the error she keeps making, this is the sentence to say when she stops, this is the book to read next, do not correct her spelling while she is still drafting. Families searching for the best IB tutor in Mumbai are usually looking for that handover without knowing it, and the tutor who gives it will change more in a term than the tutor with the longer profile.

The honest cost of the home visit is money and rigidity. Travel is paid for in either rupees or in a later slot, and a tutor who crosses a zone to reach you is pricing in the Western Express Highway whether or not it appears as a line on the invoice. In exchange you get a session that starts on time more often than not, a reading check nobody can fudge, and a weekly adult who notices that the pencil case has no sharpener in it. Over a term in the PYP, that is most of the difference between a tutor and an arrangement.
bullets: The tutor sees the real books, the light, the chair and the noise
Reading errors heard live rather than flattened by a microphone
A five-minute parent handover at the end of every visit

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one year
paragraphs: At four weeks you should see three things and no more: a routine your child expects, a baseline you can read, and one strand that has moved. The strand is usually the mechanical one, because letter formation, full stops and capital letters respond quickly to being noticed every single week. Reading level and writing stamina do not move in four weeks, and a tutor who reports that they have is describing a different child.

At one term, which in Mumbai means roughly the stretch between two reports, the markers change. She picks up a book without being told to. She writes a paragraph without asking what to write. She can say what her unit of inquiry is about in her own words, which is close to what her teacher is really assessing. Spelling accuracy has risen on the patterns that were taught and not on the ones that were not, which is how you know the teaching was specific rather than general. If none of those four has shifted after a full term of weekly sessions, the problem is the match or the method, and it is worth changing one of them rather than adding a second subject on another evening.

At one year the test is transfer. Does work done without the tutor look like work done with her. Do the school's comments change register, from reluctance and support towards independence and initiative. Does she present to her class without being pushed into it. An IB home tuition in Mumbai arrangement that has worked for a year makes itself gradually unnecessary, and a good tutor will say so before you do, usually by suggesting a fortnightly slot instead of a weekly one.

The limits are worth stating plainly. We cannot guarantee a grade, a reading level or a report comment, and anyone in this city who does is selling something other than teaching. A tutor cannot undo a bedtime at eleven o'clock, cannot replace being read to at home in any language, and cannot make a child care in nine months about a unit the school has had three years to make dull. Children also go backwards for a fortnight in the middle of real progress, almost always just after something harder has been introduced, and the right response is to wait two weeks rather than change the tutor.
bullets: Four weeks: a routine, a readable baseline, one mechanical strand moving
One term: she chooses a book and starts a paragraph unprompted

sections.heading: Starting IB home tuition in Mumbai: what to have ready
paragraphs: Four things make the first session twice as useful: the most recent report, two pages of your child's unaided writing, the title of the current unit of inquiry, and a cleared table with a chair at the right height. A home tutor for PYP transdisciplinary learning Mumbai parents book in June will ask for all four in the first message rather than in the fourth week.

On cost, what we will tell you is what it depends on rather than a number that would be wrong by area and by month. IB tuition fees in Mumbai move with the programme and the level, because a final-year PYP brief carrying exhibition-adjacent writing is not priced like Grade 1 phonics. They move with subject scarcity, because PYP-trained English specialists are thinner on the ground than Diploma Programme (DP) Maths tutors. They move with travel distance and the hour, because a seven o'clock slot across a zone costs the tutor an unpaid hour of road. They move with session length and frequency, since two shorter visits a week are rarely twice the price of one longer one, and with whether materials and marking between sessions are included. Ask for the structure in writing before the first visit, and ask what a session cancelled at short notice costs.

The first session itself follows a fixed shape. A reading check out loud, a short piece of writing at the table, a look at the last report and the current unit planner, ten minutes of actual teaching so your child meets the tutor as a teacher rather than an interviewer, and five minutes with you at the end. You should finish it holding three things: what the tutor heard, what the first four weeks will work on, and what you are being asked to do differently in the house.

Practical arrangements take one message. Give the society gate the tutor's name and a photograph so weekly entry stops being a negotiation, agree a backup weekend slot for the monsoon weeks, and agree how a missed session is handled before one is missed. Send your brief with your area, your child's grade and two possible evenings, and the shortlist comes back as profiles rather than a sales call.
bullets: Have the last report, two writing samples and the unit title ready
Clear a table with a chair at the right height, away from the television

faqs.question: What does an IB PYP English home tutor in Mumbai actually charge for?
faqs.answer: You are paying for three separate things: teaching time, preparation and travel. IB tuition fees in Mumbai vary with the programme and level, the scarcity of the specialism, the distance the tutor covers and the hour you want. A PYP English brief that involves reading the unit planner and marking a draft between visits carries preparation that a drill-based arrangement does not. Travel is the item parents underestimate, because a tutor crossing from Andheri to Worli for a seven o'clock slot spends an unpaid hour on the road. Ask for the rate, the session length, the cancellation rule and whether materials are included, in writing, before the first visit.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to Kharghar or Panvel for an evening slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the tutor already lives in Navi Mumbai. Kharghar and Panvel are matched node to node from Vashi, Nerul and Belapur along Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, and that arrangement holds for a full term. What does not hold is a tutor brought across the creek from the island city or the Western Suburbs for a weekday six o'clock slot. The Atal Setu has shortened that drive considerably and it is still the wrong structure: the tutor is fine for three weeks, then starts asking to move to Saturday. If your node genuinely has no PYP English specialist, a hybrid week beats a long commute.

faqs.question: How does a tutor get through my society gate every week?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor once rather than negotiating weekly. Most Mumbai societies accept a standing entry for a named visitor with a photo identity on file, which is why IB Gram asks every home tutor to carry a government photo document. Give the gate the name, the day and the time window, and tell your own security desk rather than relying on the app alone. In towers using a visitor-management app, add the tutor as a recurring visitor so approval does not depend on someone answering a phone mid-session. Where a society insists on a fresh pass each visit, build ten minutes into the slot so the lesson does not lose that time.

faqs.question: Do I need to sit in the room during a home session?
faqs.answer: No, and for most children you should not. Sit in for the first session so you hear the reading check and the tutor's findings, then move to the next room with the door open. A seven-year-old performs for a parent in the room and stops trying things she might get wrong, which is the opposite of what a PYP English session needs. What you should keep is the last five minutes, with your child present, where the tutor names the specific error and the specific sentence to use when your child stalls over homework. For a very young child with a short attention span, staying nearby occasionally helps.

faqs.question: My child reads fluently but writes very little. Is that an English problem?
faqs.answer: It is usually a structure problem rather than a language one. Fluent readers who write three lines generally have no model for what a paragraph is, no plan to work from, and a strong sense that writing is a thing you get marked down for. A PYP English tutor works in the opposite order from school: she gets the ideas out in speech first, writes them down as your child says them, then hands the pencil back. The unit of inquiry supplies the content so nothing has to be invented. Expect stamina to move over a term rather than a fortnight, and expect handwriting to get worse before it gets better.

faqs.question: Is online tuition good enough for PYP English?
faqs.answer: For upper PYP writing work, nearly; for early reading, no. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can teach paragraph structure, planning, vocabulary and editing well, and can reach a specialist your own area does not have. What a screen cannot do is hear a decoding error accurately, see the pencil grip, turn a physical book, or let a child rehearse presenting to a person in a room. Children in Grades 1 to 3 also treat a screen as something that can be half-watched. The workable arrangement for most Mumbai families is one home visit for reading and oral work plus one short online session midweek for the written piece.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out after three weeks?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we replace the tutor, with no argument about notice. Say what is wrong in one line, because the detail decides who comes next: too fast, too gentle, no written notes, the child is bored, the slot keeps moving. Most mismatches at three weeks are about pace rather than knowledge, so the replacement brief becomes specific instead of a fresh guess. We will ask you to keep the same day and the same slot if you can, because the routine is the part that took three weeks to build. If the problem is the hour rather than the person, changing the time is faster than changing the tutor.

faqs.question: We live off Ghodbunder Road in Thane. Will the monsoon commute cancel sessions?
faqs.answer: Some evenings, yes, and the fix is a named backup slot rather than optimism. Ghodbunder Road sets the schedule in Thane: a tutor near the station reaches Kasarvadavali in twenty minutes off-peak and nearly an hour in the evening peak, and a July downpour makes that unpredictable. Match inside Thane rather than pulling a tutor from Mulund across the Eastern Express Highway, take the earliest workable evening slot, and agree a Saturday morning fallback in June before the rain starts. A tutor living in your own corridor loses a session or two across a monsoon; one travelling across the city loses the whole arrangement.

faqs.question: How long before I see progress in my child's reading?
faqs.answer: Four weeks for the habit, one term for the level. In the first month you should see her picking up a book without an argument and self-correcting when she misreads, both of which a tutor can report specifically rather than as encouragement. A measurable move in reading level takes a term of weekly sessions plus reading at home on the other six days, and the home reading is the larger half of that. We cannot guarantee a reading level by a particular date, and anyone who offers one is quoting a number they have no way to produce. Ask your tutor which errors she heard this month against last month.

faqs.question: Should I ask for a PYP-trained teacher or will any English tutor do?
faqs.answer: Ask for PYP experience specifically. A strong CBSE or ICSE English tutor will lift grammar accuracy and comprehension speed, and will still be teaching a different subject from the one your child's report describes, because PYP language outcomes are assessed inside units of inquiry against strands and learner profile attributes. The practical test is to ask a candidate what she would do with a unit on migration if the child reads two years below her grade. Someone who has taught in an IB primary answers with the unit planner and the language strand. Someone who has not answers with a worksheet level and a weekly test.

faqs.question: Can the same tutor help with the units of inquiry as well as English?
faqs.answer: Yes, and in the PYP that separation barely exists. The language work and the inquiry work are the same work: the reflection, the research notes, the presentation and the write-up are all places where English is assessed. A PYP English tutor should be reading the current unit planner and building the session's reading and writing around it rather than running a parallel syllabus of her own. What one tutor should not try to carry is every subject at once. If the real gap is mathematical thinking or science vocabulary, that is a separate brief and often a different tutor, and those requests have their own pages here.

faqs.question: My child is in her final PYP year. Should we start English support now or wait?
faqs.answer: Start now, in June or July, not in January. The final PYP year ends in portfolio season and the exhibition presentations, and both draw on writing structure and oral confidence that take two terms to build rather than two months. Starting in the first term means the tutor works on habits while there is still room in the week; starting in March means managing a deadline with whatever habits already exist. Mumbai schools also hold student-led conferences mid-year, which is a useful external checkpoint on whether the work is landing. The exhibition itself has its own dedicated page on this site.

sections.heading: Where English sits in the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) that Mumbai schools run
paragraphs: The International Baccalaureate (IB) Primary Years Programme (PYP) does not teach English as a separate walled subject. Language runs through six transdisciplinary themes, and most Mumbai PYP schools also timetable stand-alone language time alongside them. A tutor therefore has to work with both: the inquiry the class is in, and the language skills the school reports on separately.

The six themes are Who We Are, Where We Are in Place and Time, How We Express Ourselves, How the World Works, How We Organize Ourselves, and Sharing the Planet. A class spends several weeks on a unit of inquiry built from one of them, and the reading, writing, talking and presenting all sit inside that unit. When a Grade 2 class in Powai is inquiring into How We Express Ourselves through festivals, the writing task is a description of a Ganpati visarjan the child has actually seen, not a decontextualised comprehension passage. A PYP transdisciplinary learning tutor in Mumbai has to plan from the school's current programme of inquiry rather than from a graded workbook bought at a Fort bookshop.

Two other structures shape what a tutor can usefully do. The IB learner profile names the dispositions the school reports on, and three of them are mostly language: communicator, inquirer and reflective. The approaches to learning, or ATL, give the school its vocabulary for skills, and communication skills sit in there next to thinking, social, self-management and research skills. When a report says your child is developing as a communicator, that is a statement about oral and written language, and it is the thing a tutor can move. Ask your school's PYP coordinator for the current programme of inquiry and the language policy. The IB revises its programme documents on its own cycle, so work from what your school is running this year rather than a summary you found online.

The last PYP year ends with the exhibition, a long collaborative inquiry the child presents. Its language demands are real, but the exhibition has its own page on this site and its own specialists, so a PYP transdisciplinary learning IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) tutor Mumbai parents book for general English work will usually treat it as one deadline among several rather than the whole brief. There are no external PYP examinations. Reporting is descriptor-based and conference-based, which is why parents often cannot tell whether a language problem is real until Grade 4 or Grade 5.
